name: Career (Roles and Soft Skills
description: Ready to land your dream role? This assessment evaluates your target job roles, soft skills, and career goals to match you with the best opportunities on TG Nexus. This assessment is MANDATORY to join the platform and unlock access to tailored roles suited to you.

name: Entrepreneurship
description: Do you have what it takes to turn ideas into impact? The Entrepreneurship Assessment reveals your potential to thrive in the business world. Discover your entrepreneurial mindset, refine your skills, and take the first step towards building a successful venture.

name: Soft Skills
description: Soft skills are essential for success in today’s workplace. This assessment helps you evaluate your communication, teamwork, adaptability, and leadership abilities so you can grow into a well-rounded professional.

name: Leadership
description: Are you ready to lead and inspire? Evaluate your ability to influence, make strategic decisions, and drive teams toward success. Identify your leadership strengths, enhance your decision-making skills, and take the next step in becoming an impactful leader.
